name: Club Arcade DLF
summary: Existence, developer (DLF Limited), Sector 91 DLF Gardencity location, commercial type, HARERA number RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/806/538/2024/33 and under-construction status are confirmed. Starting price varies widely across sources (₹1.4–1.6 Cr from brokers vs ₹2.38 Cr on Square Yards), and the 4-floor count could not be confirmed; we also omit possession (web: 2027 / March 2028), land area (~0.89–0.9 acres) and unit count (72).

checks.web: DLF Club Arcade, high-street retail project in DLF Gardencity, Sector 91, Gurugram
checks.note: Project is widely listed as 'DLF Club Arcade'; our name order 'Club Arcade DLF' is cosmetic.
Developer is DLF Limited; the listed developer label 'Club Arcade Dlf' is a data-quality issue.

checks.note: Square Yards shows GGM/806/538/2024/33. NoBroker lists an application-style ID RERA-GRG-1545-2024, which appears to be the HARERA project/application ID rather than a conflicting registration.

We publish no possession date; web sources give 2027 or March 2028 and disagree with each other.

checks.web: ₹1.50 Cr onwards (therealtyinfo); ₹1.6 Cr (Triverse / dlfhomes); ₹2.38 Cr onwards for an 881 sq ft shop (Square Yards)
checks.note: Broker sources match ₹1.5–1.6 Cr, but Square Yards' current listing starts at ₹2.38 Cr (~59% higher). Sources disagree; our figure may reflect launch pricing.

checks.web: Retail shops / restaurants, roughly 300–4,200 sq ft (sources vary: 400–4,200; 500–5,000; 300–1,500)

checks.note: We do not publish land area; web value given for reference. NoBroker's '180 acres' is the township, not the project.

checks.note: No source clearly states 4 floors; sources mention G/1st/2nd retail levels plus 2 basements. Unit count (72) is available but we do not publish it.
